model_identifier: claude-sonnet-5 (analyst reasoning over blind_inputs, not an automated pipeline call)

dimensions.evidence_used: large used-car market; entrenched incumbents (CarMax, dealer networks) named
dimensions.rationale: Real, large market but capped by named, entrenched incumbents; no expansion path stated.
No category-level growth data.
No named trigger event.

dimensions.evidence_used: CarMax and dealer networks named as entrenched, capital-intensive incumbents
dimensions.rationale: Named incumbents are strongly established; no stated wedge/win-loss evidence vs. them.
No pre-revenue demand signal captured distinct from Traction (which is itself thin here).

dimensions.evidence_used: 'prior operating experience' (vague) but no widely reported prior exit
dimensions.rationale: Vague positive claim without specifics; explicit absence of a notable public track record is not itself negative evidence, so scored neutral rather than low.
No shipped-complexity or technical-founder evidence.
No commercial-leadership-background specifics.
No hiring/org-depth evidence.

dimensions.evidence_used: Series C targeted at $300M, actually closed at $70M
dimensions.rationale: A real, disclosed gap between stated fundraising ambition and outcome is legitimate negative milestone-pattern evidence, not mere absence.

dimensions.evidence_used: white-glove inspection, 24-hour test drive, financing, delivery bundled
dimensions.rationale: Real, specific product-value description but no quantified ROI/pain-severity narrative.

dimensions.evidence_used: described as 'genuinely differentiated' relative to a pure listings marketplace
dimensions.rationale: Explicit differentiation claim vs. a named alternative category (listings marketplaces).
No adoption-friction/time-to-value evidence.
No durability-mechanism evidence; 'operationally heavy' speaks to cost structure, not moat mechanism.
No named adjacent-expansion surface.
No CAC/pipeline data; fundraising shortfall is Financial/Track-Record evidence, not GTM-specific.
No shipped-milestone/roadmap-cadence evidence beyond the static product description.
'Significant logistics/inspection infrastructure' implies operational complexity but no hiring-plan/process evidence.
No named strategic-choice evidence beyond the product bundle itself (Product's domain).
No customer/unit-volume data.

dimensions.evidence_used: ~$9M estimated 2014 net-fee revenue vs. ~$350M 2015 gross/sale-price-inclusive revenue
dimensions.rationale: The two figures are not a comparable same-metric series (net-fee vs. gross-inclusive) and no conversion formula exists; a defensible number cannot be produced without inventing both a metric reconciliation and a scoring function.
dimensions.conflicts: 2014 figure is net take-rate revenue; 2015 figure is gross transaction value inclusive of the car's sale price -- not directly comparable.

dimensions.rationale: No retention evidence.
No usage telemetry.
No clean comparable-metric multi-period series exists (see Revenue Growth note).
No concentration/contract-durability data.

dimensions.evidence_used: disclosed maximum 9% take-rate of sale price; gross-vs-net revenue distinction
dimensions.rationale: Real, dated take-rate evidence exists, but the FROZEN Unit Economics anchors (gross margin >80%, CAC payback <12mo, LTV:CAC >3x) are SaaS-shaped and have no stated translation for a marketplace take-rate structure -- applying them would require inventing a conversion the specification does not provide.
dimensions.missing_information: Cost-side data (inspection, delivery, financing costs) to compute a contribution margin.

dimensions.rationale: No burn data.
No cash/burn-rate data.
